title: Bufalin targets E2F2 to transcriptionally inhibit LINC01410 and suppress Wnt/beta-catenin signaling in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
authors: Kang, Xiaohong; Ma, Yufei; Zhao, Hongke; Zhang, Haoling; Roy, Mridul; Liao, Mingjuan; Wei, Ying; Li, Xingqiao; Zhou, Yueyang; Xue, Huange; Yan, Xiaoxia; Zhang, Wangzheqi; Guo, Yadong; Cao, Fei; Chang, Tingmin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蟾毒灵通过E2F2转录因子调控LINC01410及Wnt信号通路，涉及TF-DNA转录调控但缺乏三维互作建模，方法以实验和机器学习为主，与TF-DNA互作建模课题部分相关。
abstract: Bufalin, a main active monomer component extracted from the Traditional Chinese Medicine toad venom, exhibits potent anti-tumour activity across diverse malignancies. However, its specific molecular targets in Oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) remain unclear. Here, we demonstrate that bufalin suppresses ESCC growth and metastasis in a concentration-dependent manner both in vitro and in vivo. RNA sequencing analysis revealed that bufalin inhibits ESCC progression by downregulating LINC01410. TCGA-ESCC data indicated that LINC01410 is highly expressed in ESCC tissues and promotes tumour progression by stabilising beta-catenin protein and activating the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. Through multiple approaches including proteome microarray screening and machine learning analyses, we identified E2F2 as a upstream transcription factor of LINC01410. We further demonstrate that bufalin induces the proteasomal degradation of E2F2, consequently silencing LINC01410 transcription and collapsing the LINC01410-Wnt/beta-catenin signalling axis. In summary, our findings indicate that bufalin targets E2F2 to downregulate LINC01410, thereby providing a potential therapeutic strategy for suppressing ESCC progression.
abstract_zh: 蟾毒灵（Bufalin）是从中药蟾酥中提取的主要活性单体成分，在多种恶性肿瘤中表现出强效抗肿瘤活性。然而，其在食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）中的具体分子靶点仍不清楚。在此，我们证明蟾毒灵在体外和体内均以浓度依赖性方式抑制ESCC的生长和转移。RNA测序分析揭示，蟾毒灵通过下调LINC01410来抑制ESCC进展。TCGA-ESCC数据表明，LINC01410在ESCC组织中高表达，并通过稳定β-catenin蛋白和激活Wnt/β-catenin通路促进肿瘤进展。通过包括蛋白质组微阵列筛选和机器学习分析在内的多种方法，我们鉴定出E2F2为LINC01410的上游转录因子。我们进一步证明，蟾毒灵诱导E2F2的蛋白酶体降解，从而沉默LINC01410转录并瓦解LINC01410-Wnt/β-catenin信号轴。总之，我们的研究结果表明，蟾毒灵靶向E2F2以下调LINC01410，从而为抑制ESCC进展提供了一种潜在的治疗策略。
